name: What Happens When Curiosity Strikes
source:
You'll play as Lee, the boy who accidentally stepped on his big brother's new gaming console. Just like a direct blessing from the heavens above, Clay offers him a deal that might save his butt from being kicked by his brother.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20397]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演李，一个不小心踩到哥哥的新游戏机的男孩。就像来自上天的直接祝福一样，克莱向他提供了一项交易，可以让他免于被他哥哥踢。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20397]引理软论坛[/url]]
